text:
Fool Night | Official Teaser #2 | Netflix
Transfloration — a technology that implants seeds into the bodies of those near death, transforming them into plants. It is the desperate measure humanity has chosen to ensure its survival.

In a distant future where thick clouds cover the sky, trapping Earth in constant winter and night, most of the planet’s vegetation has withered away. Facing a serious oxygen shortage, humanity has built a society that relies on the meager amount of oxygen provided by Transfloration.

A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother. However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.

In their first collaboration, Sunrise and Shaft present “Fool Night," 
a highly anticipated anime adaptation of the globally acclaimed manga.
All episodes start streaming on Thursday, November 26, 2026, only on Netflix.

Cast:
Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya / Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai 
Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka / Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno / Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi

Staff: 
Based on "Fool Night" by Kasumi Yasuda (currently serialized in "Big Comic Superior" published by Shogakukan Inc.) / Director: Atsushi Yukawa / Series Composition: Jin Tanaka / Character Design: Robert Sato / Assistant Director: Ryo Shimura / Visual Development: Ryo Kikuchi / Background Director: Maki Takano (J.C.STAFF) / Color Design: Hitoshi Hibino / Compositing Director: Kazunari Ishikawa (Animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (TERAEFFECT), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT) / CG Director: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano / Editing: Rie Matsubara (Edit Room Seyama) / Sound Director: Yota Tsuruoka / Music: Tatsuya Kato / Animation Production: Sunrise & Shaft / Production: "Fool Night" Production Committee

text:
Fool Night | Interview With Creators | Netflix
"Fool Night," the first collaboration between Sunrise and Shaft, is a human drama set in a dystopian future that reflects our modern times.

The production is the first collaboration between legendary Japanese animation studios Sunrise, which has long garnered worldwide attention for projects such as "Cowboy Bebop" and the Gundam series including "Mobile Suit Gundam The Witch From Mercury," and Shaft, which has captivated anime fans with unique expressive techniques in projects like "Puella Magi Madoka Magica" and the "Monogatari" series.

The two studios, both of which find beauty in the most brutal of scenes, have combined their strengths to push this project's visuals to the next level. Get an inside look at the staff's creative process and vision.

All episodes start streaming worldwide on November 26, 2026, only on Netflix.
